Business value, future roles and quickfire

takeaways: Most generative AI pilots fail because they do not start from measurable business value and a governed, AI-ready data foundation.
Microsoft Fabric unifies pipelines, notebooks, semantic models, real-time intelligence and apps on one platform, with the semantic model becoming the key context layer for agents.
Governance should be baked into the development life cycle from day one, including data quality rules, quarantining anomalies and cost attribution per domain.
hook: Why do so many enterprise AI projects never leave the pilot stage? Five-time Microsoft MVP Leon Gordon explains for data leaders and Fabric teams how value-first proofs, governance by design and strong semantic models turn AI demos into production systems.
